task_definition.task_description: Please check which light is connected in the bedroom, then prepare a restart for it and grab its current light mesh state. After that, archive that pre-restart snapshot, restart the bedroom light, and then save a maintenance record and send me an app notification.

user_input.query: Please check which light is connected in the bedroom area and confirm the device status for light_bedroom: device_id light_bedroom, online true, power_state on. Then prepare a restart for that bedroom light and grab its current light mesh state. After that, archive the pre-restart snapshot with the title Bedroom Light Pre-Restart Archive, restart the bedroom light, and save a maintenance record named light_bedroom_restart_record in /ops/iot/maintenance. Once everything is done, send a medium priority notification to user_01 through the app channel.
